_fast_mode_note: false = the full pipeline. true = the same film with the optional depth switched off, for a demo or a first look: no probe render, ONE music candidate instead of three, ONE voiceover take, no occlusion moment, no style card. Measured 19.8: it takes a run from about 70 minutes to about 45, and about USD 1.20 off the bill. Every GATE still runs: the cost cap, the policy check, the lint, the overlay QA, the VO flow gate and the music audibility gate. Fast mode removes choices, never checks.
_review_brief_note: false = full autopilot, the product's promise. true = the run stops ONCE after the brief and shot plan are written and before any credit moves, prints them, and waits. Asked for by an outside reviewer who wanted a say in the film's argument, not in its settings. It is the only gate that can be added without breaking the one-command promise, because it costs nothing and happens before the money.
_audio_track_usd_note: Genrupt returns no price preview for audio. Measured ~3 credits (~USD 0.20) per track on a clean single-session run. Count tracks and add them to the running total by hand.
